VAR audio released for controversial Manchester derby goal

The audio from the Video Assistant Referee (VAR) review for Erling Haaland's goal in the Manchester derby between Manchester City and Manchester United has been made public. Howard Webb, chief of Professional Game Match Officials Limited (PGMOL), stated that 'tunnel vision' by VAR officials led to the error in awarding the goal. The goal was initially disallowed for offside before being overturned after a VAR review. Webb is expected to make a public statement regarding the controversy.
